authorization.scope: public agenda PBE benchmarks, agenda informational rents, U-M rent difference, ex-ante linked images and agenda-information interaction; no manuscript, tag, merge or push

domain.private_fiber: eta=(rho,nu_off) on interior priors with the frozen Bayes diagonal; eta=(*,nu) at endpoints
domain.public_information: theta is common knowledge before the agenda proposal and the posterior is degenerate after every history

payoff_dates.no_agenda_rent_transport_to_A: multiply the complete N7 rent vector by beta exactly once before forming an interaction

solution_concept.continuation_selection: M/S selects the payoff-anonymous symmetric continuation class with canonical literal uniform recognition and coalition lottery
solution_concept.current_proposal_symmetry: not imposed; every H lottery over current payoff-tied majority coalitions is preserved
solution_concept.proposal_tie_break: none added; at a pass-delay payoff tie all best passing and rejecting proposals and all mixtures are retained

public_continuation.majority_hegemon_R1: p_M(o)=beta*o for o<=1/m and p_M(o)=o for o>1/m
public_continuation.majority_weak_R1: w_M(o)=(1-beta*o)/m for o<=1/m and w_M(o)=1/m for o>1/m
public_continuation.external_option_accounting: when majority excludes H, o is external to the unit pie and every weak state receives 1/m under the symmetric continuation

public_economic_summaries.member_generator: any probability law over proposals paying the threshold to exactly k weak states, zero to the other c weak states, and retaining P_I(o)=1-k*beta*(1-beta*o)/m
public_economic_summaries.selection_status: all named coalition laws retained; immediate agreement is strict

public_economic_summaries.member_generator: any probability law over proposals paying beta/m to exactly k weak states and zero to the other c weak states
any probability law supported on optimal minimal passing proposals and proposals with fewer than k weak yes votes
public_economic_summaries.agreement_probability: any alpha in [0,1], linked to the same proposal mixture

public_economic_summaries.member_generator: any proposal receiving fewer than k weak yes votes
public_economic_summaries.selection_status: all optimal deliberately rejected proposals retained

public_economic_summaries.member_generator: unique on-path proposal pays the threshold to every weak state
public_economic_summaries.selection_status: unique proposal, result and payoff on path

public_gap_G.sign: positive for o<=1/m; for o>1/m sign G=sign(c/m-beta*o)

public_payoff_functions.ex_ante: apply (1-nu,nu) to the linked type vector after both type payoffs are computed

agenda_rent_operator.preference_rule: private U strictly beats M for theta iff DeltaRI_A^theta>G(o_theta)
agenda_rent_operator.atomicity: each type vector comes from one complete private binder; no marginal recombination
agenda_rent_operator.none_rule: if the required private source or AC fiber is empty, the corresponding rent or rent contrast is none

interaction_operator.exact_set_rule: form products of complete records at the same primitives before taking vector differences; no cross-world coupling or selector
interaction_operator.none_rule: if either required source is none, the composed interaction is none and the surviving source remains separately recorded

unanimity_interaction_cells.sign: low zero; counterfactual high strictly negative; ex ante zero
both coordinates weakly negative; both strictly negative iff u<z_H; both zero at u=z_H
both zero after transporting the N7 rent from R1 to A

majority_rent_and_interaction.agenda_rent: exact translation of the frozen A_M linked payoff vectors by -(h_M(o_0),h_M(o_1))
majority_rent_and_interaction.interaction: exact vector difference RI_M^A-beta*RI_M^{N,R1} with full source records retained

two_layer_signature.public_exact: complete public binder by rule and public type, including current named proposal law, every vote after every proposal, degenerate beliefs and literal M/S continuation
two_layer_signature.public_economic: type payoff of H, agreement-delay law and anonymous realized outcome law
two_layer_signature.factorization: declared payoff and rent operators factor measurably through complete source economic summaries after the exact products are formed
two_layer_signature.scope_limit: named coalition laws, proposal identity, raw off-path functions and cross-world realization relations remain exact-layer objects
two_layer_signature.reynolds_status: no Reynolds barycenter is treated as an assessment, PBE representative or selector

source_rent_record_ids.institutional_contrast_cells: the nine frozen N7-DRI cells, including explicit none cells

complete_records_export.contents: complete public equilibrium family records by symbolic public type plus complete benchmark, rent, contrast and interaction source tuples
complete_records_export.self_hash_rule: the complete-record file contains no hash of itself; this interface and the external candidate manifest pin its bytes

canonical_dag.role: immutable Gate 0 topology and provenance only; its historical pending lifecycle is not the current AR lifecycle

invalidation: any source-byte, M/S/B, quota, equality, payoff-date, domain or interaction-operator change invalidates this candidate; AR never changes AC or N7 retroactively
